plan.decision: No promotion unless all AP-16 acceptance checks pass; shared-host evidence remains exploratory.

allocation.scope: prepared Engine registration, debit, rollback, commit and service; excludes runtime I/O/timers

single_slot.interpretation: brackets publication to next successful grant observation; includes offered arrival and scheduler delay, not physical publication timestamps

limitations: recipient tail samples correlated by fanout
paired_inference_limit: Seven sequential shared-host pairs (healthy controls three); descriptive resampling, not dedicated-host significance or production qualification.

retention_grid.selection: Additional exploratory grid at 0.9/1.0/1.1 times 2.4 MB/s (32 slots per 20 ms synchronized cycle); same trace selection and native checks are not independent confirmation.

columnar_format: Each records row follows its adjacent columns list; null marks an inapplicable or unmeasured value.
failure_history: 100-recipient scratch capacity regression fixed with prepared backend scratch
Miri scripted wall-clock expiry fixed with paused virtual time
Three complete-frame accounting regressions failed before the final fix
Initial sanitizer qualification missing compiler metadata was incomplete
Empty Loom selector rejected; reduced feature selection did not meet intended model count; feature-complete run passed
First confirmation stopped for accounting fix; historical outcomes retained separately

software_perf.scope: single profiled 5s whole-process runs, excluded from timing campaign
